description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score (y-axis) and Average Lagging (AL) (x-axis) for four different training methods in simultaneous machine translation, as presented in the paper “Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine Translation.” The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” ranges from 0.0 to 10.0 with tick marks at intervals of 2.5, and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” ranges from 18 to 29 with major gridlines at intervals of 2, also on a linear scale. Four distinct lines are plotted: “Consistency-CE” (purple circles with dashed line) starts at approximately BLEU 18.5 at AL 0.0 and rises steadily to about BLEU 27.0 at AL 10.0; “Inconsistency-CE” (purple squares with dashed line) begins at BLEU 20.0 at AL 0.0 and increases to roughly BLEU 27.0 at AL 10.0; “Inconsistency-CE-MP” (blue squares with dash-dot line) starts at BLEU 18.3 at AL 0.0 and climbs to approximately BLEU 27.2 at AL 10.0; and “Consistency-Bi” (red stars with solid line) begins at BLEU 21.5 at AL 0.0, rises sharply to BLEU 28.5 at AL 8.75, then slightly declines to BLEU 28.3 at AL 10.0. All lines show a general upward trend in BLEU as AL increases, with “Consistency-Bi” achieving the highest BLEU scores across most of the range.
